answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the river of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A vertex of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nadir of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
